sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一名女性的遗体在加利福尼亚州的一处葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到了斩首，体内的血液已被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机，试图掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“无名氏”。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，查明身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“Casefile Presents”推出的全新系列，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: In the 1950s and 60s, Australian reporter and journalist Rupert Murdoch became the senior executive of his own private news proprietor company.
sentences.zh: 20世纪50和60年代，澳大利亚记者兼报业大亨鲁珀特·默多克成为了他私人新闻集团的高级主管。

sentences.en: After acquiring a number of newspapers in Australia and New Zealand, Rupert's enterprise expanded into the United Kingdom,
sentences.zh: 在收购了澳大利亚和新西兰的多家报纸后，鲁珀特的商业版图扩展到了英国。

sentences.en: and in 1969, he attended an auction for the largest circulating national gazette, the News of the World.
sentences.zh: 1969年，他参加了当时发行量最大的全国性报纸《世界新闻报》的拍卖会。

sentences.en: A spirited bidding contest ensued, wherein Rupert defeated the £34 million offer from business rival Robert Maxwell,
sentences.zh: 随后展开了一场激烈的竞标，鲁珀特击败了商业对手罗伯特·麦克斯韦3400万英镑的报价，

sentences.en: securing ownership of the newspaper and its sister publication, The Sun.
sentences.zh: 成功获得了该报及其姊妹刊物《太阳报》的所有权。

sentences.en: Having secured his position as chairman of the News of the World group,
sentences.zh: 在稳固了自己作为《世界新闻报》集团董事长的地位后，

sentences.en: Rupert entrusted the role of the company's deputy chairman to 60-year-old Alec Mackay, an Australian newspaper executive with over a decade of industry experience.
sentences.zh: 鲁珀特将公司副董事长的职位交给了60岁的亚历克·麦凯，他是一位拥有十多年行业经验的澳大利亚报业高管。

sentences.en: Alec had spent the previous 12 years in England working for Mirror Group newspapers, proprietors of the Daily Mirror and The People, amongst others.
sentences.zh: 亚历克此前在英国镜报集团工作了12年，该集团旗下拥有《每日镜报》和《人物报》等报刊。

sentences.en: It was whilst working for Mirror Group newspapers that Alec was poached by Rupert Murdoch to spearhead his recently acquired publications.
sentences.zh: 正是在镜报集团工作期间，亚历克被鲁珀特·默多克挖走，负责领导他新收购的出版物。

sentences.en: Alec lived with his wife Muriel in south-west London's upscale district of Wimbledon, near the world-famous tennis club.
sentences.zh: 亚历克与妻子穆里尔住在伦敦西南部高档的温布尔登区，靠近世界闻名的网球俱乐部。

sentences.en: The couple's Georgian-style manor titled St. Mary's House was situated on Arthur Road, a quiet, leafy street framed by spacious villas home to London's professional elite,
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇的乔治亚风格庄园名为“圣玛丽之家”，坐落在亚瑟路，这是一条安静、绿树成荫的街道，周围环绕着伦敦精英阶层居住的宽敞别墅，

sentences.en: stockbrokers, bankers, and business executives.
sentences.zh: 包括股票经纪人、银行家和企业高管。

sentences.en: In December 1969, Rupert Murdoch and his wife Anna made plans to holiday in Australia over Christmas.
sentences.zh: 1969年12月，鲁珀特·默多克和妻子安娜计划去澳大利亚过圣诞节。

sentences.en: During their absence, Alec Mackay was assigned to the role of acting chairman of the News of the World
sentences.zh: 在他们离开期间，亚历克·麦凯被任命为《世界新闻报》集团的代理董事长，

sentences.en: Group and tasked with overseeing Rupert's business duties.
sentences.zh: 负责监管鲁珀特的业务职责。

sentences.en: As acting chairman, Alec was provided with the Murdoch's deep blue Rolls-Royce and its accompanying chauffeur.
sentences.zh: 作为代理董事长，亚历克获准使用默多克夫妇那辆深蓝色的劳斯莱斯及其专属司机。

sentences.en: On December 19, 1969, Rupert and Anna Murdoch departed for their Australian getaway.
sentences.zh: 1969年12月19日，鲁珀特和安娜·默多克启程前往澳大利亚度假。

sentences.en: Ten days later, on the morning of Monday December 29, Alec Mackay was picked up from his home in the company's Rolls-Royce
sentences.zh: 十天后，即12月29日星期一上午，亚历克·麦凯乘坐公司的劳斯莱斯从家中出发，

sentences.en: and driven to the News of the World Group office in central London, where he remained for the rest of the day.
sentences.zh: 被送往位于伦敦市中心的《世界新闻报》集团办公室，并在那里待了一整天。

sentences.en: 55-year-old Muriel Mackay dressed in a green woollen jersey suit, a black and white Czech topcoat,
sentences.zh: 55岁的穆里尔·麦凯身穿绿色羊毛衫套装，外罩一件黑白相间的捷克大衣，

sentences.en: and cream-coloured leather shoes, and headed out in her Ford Capri to run some errands.
sentences.zh: 脚蹬奶油色皮鞋，开着她的福特卡普里车出门办事去了。

sentences.en: She went shopping and visited the dentist, returning home to Wimbledon at 5pm.
sentences.zh: 她去购物并看了牙医，于下午5点回到温布尔登的家中。

sentences.en: After finishing work for the day, Alec Mackay was chauffeured home, arriving to St. Mary's house at 7.45pm.
sentences.zh: 结束一天的工作后，亚历克·麦凯由司机送回家，于晚上7点45分抵达圣玛丽之家。

sentences.en: When he reached the front door, Alec noticed some sheets of yesterday's newspaper on the ground from the People publication, dated December 28.
sentences.zh: 当他走到前门时，亚历克注意到地上有一些昨天的《人物报》，日期是12月28日。

sentences.en: He pressed the doorbell with three short rings and one long, a special code designed by Muriel to signal when her husband was at the door.
sentences.zh: 他按了三短一长的门铃，这是穆里尔设计的特殊暗号，用来示意丈夫到家了。

sentences.en: The precaution was established after a burglary at the Mackay's home months earlier in September, which had claimed most of Muriel's jewellery, as well as her sense of safety.
sentences.zh: 这个预防措施是在几个月前的9月，麦凯家发生入室盗窃案后设立的，那次盗窃案不仅让穆里尔损失了大部分珠宝，也让她失去了安全感。

sentences.en: Since then, she had also installed a chain lock on the front door, keeping it secured in its latch at all times.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，她还在前门安装了防盗链，并始终保持锁扣状态。

sentences.en: Even with these safeguards, Muriel refused to open the door until she confirmed it was indeed Alec standing on the other side.
sentences.zh: 即便有这些防护措施，穆里尔在确认门外确实是亚历克之前，也拒绝开门。

sentences.en: When Muriel failed to come to the door, Alec rang the doorbell three more times, assuming his wife was upstairs and out of earshot.
sentences.zh: 当穆里尔没有来开门时，亚历克又按了三次门铃，以为妻子在楼上没听见。

sentences.en: When his rings went unanswered, Alec twisted the handle and was surprised to discover the door was unlocked, the chain unlatched and dangling by the doorframe.
sentences.zh: 在无人应答后，亚历克转动把手，惊讶地发现门没锁，防盗链也已解开，正挂在门框上。

sentences.en: He entered the house, noticing the lights were on inside, but his calls for Muriel were met with silence.
sentences.zh: 他走进屋内，发现灯亮着，但他呼唤穆里尔的声音却无人回应。

sentences.en: Further within the entrance hallway, a large chair had been pulled away from a wall and now stood in the centre of the corridor.
sentences.zh: 在入口大厅深处，一把大椅子被从墙边移开，现在正立在走廊中央。

sentences.en: Muriel's handbag lay open on the floor, its contents scattered about, along with more sheets of the People newspaper dated December 28.
sentences.zh: 穆里尔的手提包敞开着掉在地上，里面的东西散落一地，旁边还有更多日期为12月28日的《人物报》。

sentences.en: A two-and-a-half-inch strip of elastoplast tape was twisted over on itself on a table, while a large quantity of baling twine was tangled in a messy bundle on a chair.
sentences.zh: 桌上有一条两英寸半长的医用胶带扭曲在一起，椅子上则有一团乱糟糟的打包绳。

sentences.en: The hallway telephone had been ripped away from the wall and was overturned on the floor.
sentences.zh: 走廊里的电话线被从墙上扯断，电话机翻倒在地。

sentences.en: Alec's eyes were then drawn to a foreign object resting on the nearby writing desk.
sentences.zh: 亚历克的目光随后被放在附近写字台上的一件异物吸引。

sentences.en: The machete-like cutting tool consisted of a long, curved blade and was known as a billhook, an instrument typically used in agriculture.
sentences.zh: 那是一种类似砍刀的切割工具，有着长长的弯曲刀刃，被称为“钩刀”，通常用于农业生产。

sentences.en: Alec was certain his property had once again fallen prey to burglars, but it wasn't until he came across Muriel's pet Dachshund that he sensed something far more sinister
sentences.zh: 亚历克确信家里再次遭到了窃贼光顾，但直到他看到穆里尔养的腊肠犬时，他才感觉到发生了更可怕的事情。

sentences.en: had taken place.
sentences.zh: 那只小狗正躺在客厅地板上，对着巨大的开放式壁炉。

sentences.en: The small dog was resting on the living room floor in front of the large, open fireplace.
sentences.zh: 壁炉里正燃着噼啪作响的木柴。

sentences.en: A crackling log fire blazed within.
sentences.zh: 穆里尔以前曾有两只狗死于火灾，因此她总是确保壁炉在使用时有防护网遮挡。

sentences.en: Muriel had previously lost two dogs in a fire and, as a consequence, always made sure that a protective screen was covering the fireplace whenever it was in use.
sentences.zh: 而这一次，防护网没有立起来，亚历克知道妻子绝不会在没有安好防护网的情况下离开家。

sentences.en: On this occasion, the screen was not up, and Alec knew his wife would never leave the house without ensuring it was in place.
sentences.zh: 进一步检查后，他还发现电视开着，穆里尔出门时通常穿的鞋子整齐地放在楼梯上，而她的车还在车库里。

sentences.en: Upon further inspection, he also noticed the television was on, the shoes Muriel typically wore when heading out were neatly perched on the stairs, and her car was in the garage.
sentences.zh: 担心入侵者可能还在屋内，而穆里尔可能躲在某处保护自己，

sentences.en: Fearing the intruder may still be in the house and Muriel might be hiding somewhere to protect herself,
sentences.zh: 亚历克拿起那把钩刀，冲上楼检查了六间卧室和两间浴室，同时不断呼唤着妻子的名字。

sentences.en: Alec armed himself with the billhook and rushed upstairs to check the six bedrooms and two bathrooms, all the while calling out for his wife.
sentences.zh: 当发现每个房间都空无一人时，亚历克又检查了车库和花园，但一无所获。

sentences.en: When he found each room empty, Alec checked the garage and the garden, but to no avail.
sentences.zh: 穆里尔失踪了。

sentences.en: Muriel was gone.
sentences.zh: 亚历克匆忙跑到邻居家报警，大约十分钟后，警察抵达了圣玛丽之家。

sentences.en: Alec hurried to a neighbour's house to raise the alarm, and the police arrived to St Mary's house some ten minutes later.
sentences.zh: 他们立即注意到有人从外面用力推过挂着防盗链的前门，

sentences.en: They immediately noticed signs that someone outside had applied bodily pressure to the chained front door
sentences.zh: 并强行闯入，警方断定这只需要轻微的推力。

sentences.en: and forced their way in, an act which police determined only required light pushing.
sentences.zh: 入口大厅的凌乱状态，加上胶带、打包绳和钩刀的出现，

sentences.en: The disarranged state of the entrance hallway, coupled with the presence of the adhesive tape, baling twine and billhook,
sentences.zh: 这些东西都不属于麦凯家，勾勒出一幅可怕的画面。

sentences.en: none of which belonged to the Mackay's, painted a grim picture.
sentences.zh: 清点发现，穆里尔剩下的珠宝不见了，她那件黄褐色与黑色双面大衣也不见了。

sentences.en: An inventory revealed that Muriel's remaining jewellery was gone, along with her fawn and black reversible coat.
sentences.zh: 然而，抢劫似乎只是作案者的次要动机。

sentences.en: Yet, robbery seemed to be the perpetrator's secondary motive.
sentences.zh: 穆里尔·麦凯似乎是被绑架了，钩刀很可能是用来恐吓她的，当时她被胶带封住了嘴，并用打包绳捆绑起来。

sentences.en: It appeared as though Muriel Mackay had been abducted, the billhook likely used to intimidate her as she was gagged with the adhesive tape and bound with the baling twine.
sentences.zh: 亚历克描述妻子中等身材，身高五英尺九英寸，留着棕色头发。

sentences.en: Alec described his wife as medium build, five foot nine inches tall, with brown hair.
sentences.zh: 他告诉警方，穆里尔那天早上精神状态一如既往地好，还准备了晚餐，仿佛在等待他回家。

sentences.en: He informed police that Muriel was her usual bright self that morning and had also prepared their dinner, as though she was awaiting his arrival home.
sentences.zh: 当警官带着追踪犬在当地搜寻时，

sentences.en: As officers canvassed the local area with tracking dogs,
sentences.zh: 穆里尔的家人和朋友也接到了通知，包括她的三个成年子女：伊恩、黛安和詹妮弗。

sentences.en: Muriel's family and friends were contacted, including her three adult children, Ian, Diane and Jennifer.
sentences.zh: 没有人能说出谁会针对这位善良温柔的祖母，她显然深受身边人的爱戴。

sentences.en: No one could offer the names of anyone who might target the kind and gentle grandmother, who was clearly beloved by those who knew her.
sentences.zh: 亚历克和穆里尔出生并成长于南澳大利亚的阿德莱德，两人是青梅竹马。

sentences.en: Alec and Muriel were born and raised in Adelaide in South Australia, and the pair were childhood sweethearts.
sentences.zh: 多年后，当亚历克在广告业崭露头角时，他们结婚了。

sentences.en: They married many years later, as Alec was making a name for himself in advertising.
sentences.zh: 在结识了包括克里·帕克在内的新闻界精英后，

sentences.en: After befriending members of the press elite, including Kerry Packer,
sentences.zh: 亚历克投身于印刷媒体行业。

sentences.en: Alec pursued a career in print media.
sentences.zh: 穆里尔一直是一位支持丈夫的妻子，在他们搬迁到伦敦期间始终陪伴左右，并帮助他在出版圈建立人脉。

sentences.en: Muriel was forever the supportive wife, standing by her husband during their relocation to London and helping him network amongst publishing circles.
sentences.zh: 业余时间，穆里尔沉浸在她最喜欢的爱好——绘画中，她在这方面很有天赋。

sentences.en: In her spare time, Muriel indulged in her favourite hobby, painting, for which she had quite the talent.
sentences.zh: 为了让更多人关注妻子的失踪，

sentences.en: Desperate to raise awareness of his wife's disappearance,
sentences.zh: 亚历克·麦凯向他在新闻界的朋友和同事寻求帮助。

sentences.en: Alec Mackay sought help from his colleagues and friends in the press.
sentences.zh: 他给《世界新闻报》集团旗下《太阳报》的编辑打了电话，引得大批记者涌向亚瑟路。

sentences.en: He called the editor of News of the World Group newspaper The Sun, prompting throngs of journalists to descend on Arthur Road.
sentences.zh: 他们的出现让警方感到沮丧，警方认为这些干预的媒体是一种干扰和负担。

sentences.en: Their presence frustrated police, who found the meddling media to be a distraction and liability.
sentences.zh: 距离穆里尔·麦凯被报失踪已经过去了五个小时，麦凯家依然挤满了警察、

sentences.en: Five hours had passed since Muriel Mackay was reported missing, and the Mackay property was still trawling with police officers,
sentences.zh: 媒体成员以及焦急的朋友和亲戚。

sentences.en: members of the press, and concerned friends and relatives.
sentences.zh: 家里的电话已经恢复并重新接通，凌晨1点15分，电话突然响了。

sentences.en: The house phone had since been restored and reconnected, when at 1.15am it suddenly rang.
sentences.zh: 麦凯的女婿大卫接了电话，一个陌生的男声问道：“这是麦凯先生的家吗？”

sentences.en: The Mackay's son-in-law, David, answered, as an unknown male voice asked, is that the home of Mr. Mackay?
sentences.zh: 大卫回答说：“你找他有什么事？”

sentences.en: To which David responded, who wants him?
sentences.zh: 打电话的人解释道：“告诉麦凯先生，这是M3，黑手党。”

sentences.en: The caller explained, tell Mr. Mackay it is the M3, the Mafia.
sentences.zh: 大卫把听筒递给亚历克，对方继续说道：“这是黑手党第3小组，我们来自美国，

sentences.en: David handed the receiver to Alec as the caller went on, this is the Mafia Group 3, we are from America,
sentences.zh: 黑手党M3，我们抓了你妻子，周三前你需要准备一百万英镑，你最好搞到钱，你有朋友，找他们要，

sentences.en: Mafia M3, we have your wife, you will need one million pounds by Wednesday, you had better get it, you have friends, get it from them,
sentences.zh: 周三晚上前准备好一百万英镑，否则我们就杀了她。”

sentences.en: have one million pounds by Wednesday night, or we will kill her.
sentences.zh: 一名在分机上监听的侦探记录下了这段对话，观察到打电话的人听起来有西印度口音，并带有美国腔调。

sentences.en: A detective listening in on an extension took note of the conversation, observing the caller had what sounded like a West Indian accent with hints of American overtones.
sentences.zh: 这一点得到了接线员的证实，他当时还在线上确保通话连接，

sentences.en: This was confirmed by the call operator, who was still on the line ensuring the call connected,
sentences.zh: 接线员告知当局，这通威胁电话是从埃平郊区的一个公用电话亭打出的，

sentences.en: The operator informed authorities that the threatening call had been placed from a public telephone box in the suburb of Epping,
sentences.zh: 位于温布尔登东北50公里处。

sentences.en: 50 kilometres northeast of Wimbledon.
sentences.zh: 在神秘的M3打来的电话得到证实之前，警方继续将穆里尔的失踪视为人口失踪案处理。

sentences.en: Until the call from the mysterious M3 could be authenticated, police continued to treat Muriel's disappearance as a missing persons case.
sentences.zh: 虽然他们没有排除绑架的可能性，但这似乎极不可能，因为在英国从未听说过此类犯罪。

sentences.en: Although they didn't rule out the possibility of kidnapping, it seemed highly unlikely as such crimes were unheard of in Britain.
sentences.zh: 当被记者问及是否在调查真实的赎金要求时，一名侦探回答说：“我们怎么知道？”

sentences.en: When asked by a reporter if they were investigating a genuine ransom demand, a detective responded, how do we know?
sentences.zh: “我们以前从未遇到过这种情况。”

sentences.en: We've never had one before.
sentences.zh: 相反，怀疑的目光投向了亚历克·麦凯，甚至穆里尔本人。

sentences.en: Instead, a suspicious eye was cast towards Alec Mackay and even Muriel herself.
sentences.zh: 鉴于这起犯罪涉及一位恰好监管着全国两大报纸的报业高管，人们开始猜测整个事件

sentences.en: Given the crime involved a newspaper executive who happened to oversee the country's two biggest tabloids, speculation arose as to whether the entire situation
sentences.zh: 是否是一场宣传噱头或恶作剧。

sentences.en: was a publicity stunt or hoax.
sentences.zh: 这个耸人听闻的故事直接被印成了报纸，标题引人注目：

sentences.en: The sensational story had gone straight to print with the attention-grabbing headline,
sentences.zh: “你见过这个女人吗？”

sentences.en: Have you seen this woman?
sentences.zh: 配图是穆里尔微笑着的黑白照片。

sentences.en: Accompanied by a black and white photograph of a smiling Muriel.
